title: Because You Showed Me the Way

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket's been turning up the heat
in the recent scrimmages.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
FINIIISH!
Winning Ticket takes first priiize!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Did you see it?! My outstanding victoryyy!
The glory's all mine,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though some days are filled with laughter
and joy...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I-I lost... No...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ug...
Waaaaah! This suuucks! I'm retraining
from  scraaatch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Other days are filled—no, drowned—with
tears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both wins and losses continue to pile up. 
And today...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nooooo! I looooost!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
Trainer! I have to keep training
more and more!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's it! I'll train sooo hard!
Full-speed
training! First, a lap around
the track—NO!
A lap around Japan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ticket's burning herself out like usual,
so I
rush to give her a suitable
training
regimen.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Thanks! I'm going to hit the track
right now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll use this loss...
to propel me into the
Derbyyy!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how's it going? Your student's as
fired up as they say.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I don't doubt it,
but... That scrimmage loss
shows she's still a bit rough
around the
edges.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Actually,
it's not just that... She's too open
with her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Her mood rouses up the other racers. They
see her burst of speed and
feel pushed to
try harder.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She needs to hide her power and lull her
opponents into being
careless. It's an
important tactic on the track.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Aw, heck. I'm saying too much to a rival
trainer. Listen, don't worry
about it... See
ya around.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hello? Trainer! Oh no! Did your spirit
leave your body?! No!
Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking about what that trainer
said so
much, it seems to have
worried Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whahuh?! You're back from the dead! It's
a miracle! Oooh! Thank
goodneeess!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what you were thinking about? Tell
me, tell me! I'll help you
think harder!
Nnngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's always giving it her all,
so I want to
do more to help her win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But should I follow the advice and teach
her how to hide her cards?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, hnnng... I can't take it! What are
you worried about?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What can I do to help my most special
partner... There must be
somethiiing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh, aaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, seeing her try so desperately,
just like she always does, I
finally
understand.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer? Oh, hey... You look
refreshed somehow.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
really? That's... great! Really great!
Whoo-hooo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm set to go. Let's talk about my next
regimen! I'll listen at full power
to
whatever you say!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
After all, you really see me! You think
about me! That's why I trust
you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt when I'm with you! Not
one bit! I can steam forward
without
holding anything back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if for the first time,
I see the trust that
shines in her eyes... And I
become
determined to truly understand her.
